article.body:
Proposed Agentic-AI Framework Targets Energy-Aware Software Supply Chains

An arXiv research paper dated 28 September 2026 proposed an agentic-AI software framework anchored on blockchain for secure software supply chains; it is not a factory, pilot line or production operation. The described system combines resource optimisation, energy awareness, agentic AI and blockchain within software-supply-chain processes, but the available record does not specify which tasks the agents control or automate. No throughput, deployment scale, energy figure or performance result is reported. The physical and operational bottleneck determining scale—including computing resources, blockchain workload, power use and implementation requirements—remains unestablished because no supporting evidence or independent verification is available.
